title: Identity classification conflict
detail: State Council Regulation Art.52(2) includes a foreigner continuously resident in China for one year as a domestic individual; PBOC Measures Art.37 and SAFE current guide key overseas-individual treatment to passport/permit and permanent-residence-card quota. The same US citizen can be processed differently.
resolution: Ask the bank in writing which document/rule governs; escalate to local SAFE if needed. Do not assume passport alone guarantees uncapped treatment.

title: US personal FX gain character conflict
detail: §988 ordinary default vs IRS Pub 525 capital-gain instruction for personal gain >USD 200. The USD 200 amount is a recognition threshold, not a tax-free allowance.
resolution: Provide acquisition/disposition dates and basis to a US tax professional; do not report “always zero” or assume capital treatment without analysis.

title: Current inflation-adjusted FBAR maxima not verified
detail: IRM says penalties are adjusted per 31 CFR 1010.821 and incorporates Bittner, but this session did not read an official current-year adjusted dollar table. Earlier edition figures are not reused.
resolution: Check the current 31 CFR 1010.821 table / IRS penalty page before quoting adjusted dollars. Statutory framework is published; adjusted cells stay blank.

title: BOC board date mismatch and dynamic stamp
detail: Report date is 2026-11-08 UTC; retrieved BOC board displays 2026-11-09 (latest 07:14:36; earlier capture 05:30) with the same USD rates. Board is reference-only.
resolution: Re-capture the bank’s actual online/branch quote on transaction date. Ladder is a conditional scenario, not a quote.

title: SkyRemit widget internally inconsistent
detail: Retrieved markup showed send 33,333 CNY but receive 1,483.16 USD alongside rate pair 0.149900/0.149496 and CNY 79 fee; the receive amount matches a different default send amount. Only rate pair and fixed fee are used.
resolution: Obtain a logged-in transaction quote for the exact amount and funding method; confirm whether fee is deducted from send amount.

title: Wise quote is dynamic and no fee curve was harvested
detail: Live page changed during research (1,224.43→1,224.40 CNY fee; discount 31.90→31.93; balance 1,208.14→1,208.11). ?amount= did not alter the server-rendered 200,000 CNY quote. SkyRemit usage shares the Wise limit.
resolution: Use the authenticated Wise quote for each amount; do not extrapolate the single point. Cancel unfunded transfers if they consume limit.

title: ICBC wire fees not extractable
detail: ICBC price index publishes international-business fees as GIF images; numeric wire fees were not extractable. Overseas-branch tariffs are not substitutes.
resolution: Open the GIF/branch tariff manually or ask ICBC for a written quote; leave blank until then.

title: Western Union outbound fee/limit unverified
detail: Provider page lists partner banks and cash pickup but no complete outbound fee schedule; bank-account delivery temporarily unavailable.
resolution: Obtain a partner-bank/WU written quote and limit confirmation before relying on the route.

title: Correspondent and receiving-bank fees unknown
detail: BOC/HSBC tariffs exclude or pass through non-HSBC/overseas charges. Optional full-arrival/pre-charge amounts are not a verified all-in corridor cost.
resolution: Ask both banks for SHA/BEN/OUR or full-delivery pricing and the receiving bank’s inbound fee; keep blank until confirmed.

title: Personal tax and eligibility facts absent
detail: No source of funds, PRC/US tax residency, filing status, basis, prior FBAR/8938 history, treaty residence, account classification or property/inheritance/emigration facts were supplied.
resolution: Treat the ladder as arithmetic only. Obtain a fact-specific legal/tax review before executing; do not infer a personal tax amount.

title: HSBC FX spread and account cost unverified
detail: HSBC tariff gives local wire fees and Premier eligibility, but no live HSBC CNY→USD execution spread or total account cost was captured.
resolution: Capture HSBC’s actual FX quote and account-fee waiver status; ordinary Premier wire is not universally free.

title: Emigration-transfer eligibility unproven
detail: US citizenship alone does not establish emigration transfer eligibility; requires pre-immigrant-status property, hukou cancellation and consular residence proof.
resolution: Confirm documents with former-hukou SAFE office; do not use this route for ordinary savings without eligibility.

title: Inheritance-transfer eligibility unproven
detail: Requires foreign/HK-Macao-Taiwan heir, lawful inheritance and decedent property/tax evidence.
resolution: Confirm inheritance公证/will, property proof and tax certificate with decedent’s former-hukou SAFE office.

title: Property-sale gain and other taxes unknown
detail: 2025 guide caps outbound at sale price less taxes/fees and requires tax-certificate match, but the user’s gain, original cost, deductions and other sale taxes are unknown.
resolution: Use the actual tax certificate and sale settlement; do not apply 20% to gross proceeds.

title: Current corporate profit/divestment checklist partially unretrieved
detail: Capital Guide 2024 PDF retrieval did not return full §7.10/§7.12 body text; notice and older/service guides establish framework but not every current bank document.
resolution: Obtain the full current guide section or bank checklist before filing; corporate route steps are framework-level only.

title: QDII/securities/insurance/private wrapper outbound route unverified
detail: Retrieved sources do not establish a general personal overseas-account redemption route for QDII, securities/insurance liquidation or private wrappers.
resolution: Do not treat liquidation or an investment wrapper as an outbound entitlement; obtain product-specific official rules.

title: Cash travel, notarisation and translation costs blank
detail: Permit fee may be waived, but travel, insurance, notarisation, translation, valuation and agent costs were not verified.
resolution: Quote these locally; they are access costs, not conversion taxes.

title: Card purchase FX fees and foreign ATM surcharge blank
detail: BOC publishes ATM fees, but card purchase foreign-transaction fees and foreign ATM surcharges were not verified.
resolution: Check issuer/network terms and ATM disclosure before spending/withdrawing.

title: Service-trade outward tax filing threshold/exemptions not fully verified
detail: Genuine current-account payments may require tax filing/withholding; exact threshold/exemptions for the user’s transaction were not established.
resolution: Confirm with the competent tax authority/bank for the actual contract and payment type.

title: Prohibited-route figures are statutory exposure, not prices
detail: Fine ranges and enforcement cases describe unlawful conduct; they are not fees, assessments or safe harbours. Crypto notice has no fixed percentage.
resolution: Do not execute prohibited routes; no operational steps are published.

title: External retrievability is not continuously verified
detail: Source register records URLs read during research; the build checker validates internal links/citations/arithmetic, not live external HTTP status. Some official pages are dynamic or move.
resolution: Re-open load-bearing sources before execution; CI should not be read as proof that every external URL is currently retrievable.

title: Root portal link to Edition F pending
detail: This session does not overwrite the shared root portal owned by another session; Edition F is published under /edition-f/ and a link request is logged.
resolution: Root/portal owner to add the Edition F link after merge; direct URL remains live.
